content:
Emma: Morning — quick sync. We need a final copy pass for the onramp landing pages (Hosted API / Dedicated / Private). Launch post goes live Tue, webinar next week. Can we align messaging + lead routing?

Noah: Got it. Priority order?

Emma: Hosted (self-serve) first, then Dedicated (reserved capacity / sales), then Private (VPC/on-prem). Hosted drives trial signups, Dedicated needs clear SLA/pricing CTA, Private should gate for enterprise contact + datasheet.

Maya: I can do a microcopy scrub. Goal: tight 3-line hero, 3 bullets, one clear primary CTA. Quick variants incoming.

Zach: Design note — keep identical hero layout across modes, swap subhead + CTA. Easier for A/B and keeps page frame consistent.

Liza: Routing plan (high level): Hosted -> trial funnel; Dedicated -> Sales form + SF queue; Private -> enterprise contact + gated asset. Will add UTMs.

Emma: @Liza please paste exact UTM strings here. Also we need webhook verification for Dedicated leads.

Liza: Proposed UTMs:
- Hosted: /signup?utm_source=launch_post&utm_medium=web&utm_campaign=onramp_hosted
- Dedicated: /contact-sales?utm_source=launch_post&utm_medium=web&utm_campaign=onramp_dedicated
- Private: /enterprise-contact?utm_source=launch_post&utm_medium=web&utm_campaign=onramp_private

Noah: For Dedicated, form should route to SF queue "Dedicated_Inbound" and create lead with tags: product=dedicated, source=launch_onramp. @ops-bot can you confirm queue exists and webhook endpoint?

ops-bot: Automated check: salesforce queue "Dedicated_Inbound" exists. Webhook endpoint configured: https://hooks.redwood.internal/sf/dedicated_inbound. Auth token needs rotation (assigned to @Noah). :white_check_mark:

Maya: CTA microcopy options (short list):
- Hosted hero: "Try Hosted API" / "Start free trial"
- Dedicated hero: "Book throughput demo" / "Request capacity"
- Private hero: "Contact enterprise team" / "Request privacy datasheet"

Zach: I prefer: "Try Hosted API", "Book throughput demo", "Contact enterprise team" — keeps verbs consistent.

Emma: Webinar plan: 20-min Hosted quickstart + live Q, separate 30-min Dedicated/Private deep-dive (SRE + Sales on hand). Launch post Tue, Hosted webinar Wed (getting started), Enterprise briefing Thu (deep-dive). CTAs on pages should link accordingly.

Liza: Landing->webinar mapping:
- Hosted hero CTA -> trial (primary). Secondary link -> /webinar/hosted-onramp?utm_source=launch_post&utm_campaign=onramp_hosted_webinar
- Dedicated hero CTA -> Calendly (book throughput demo) + SF tag.
- Private hero CTA -> enterprise briefing registration (form) -> gated datasheet + follow-up sequence.

Maya: Hero copy first draft (pasting drafts below):
```
Hosted:
Hero: "Start generating in minutes — high-throughput, predictable inference."
Subhead: "Hosted API with streaming, function calling, and transparent performance."
Bullets: "Low-latency SLOs" / "Per-token cost controls" / "Prefix caching & batching"
Primary CTA: "Try Hosted API"
Secondary: "Join Getting Started webinar"

Dedicated:
Hero: "Reserved GPU capacity for predictable production throughput."
Subhead: "Capacity you control — autoscale, SLAs, and tenant isolation."
Bullets: "Guaranteed throughput" / "Burst capacity options" / "SLA-backed latency targets"
Primary CTA: "Book throughput demo"
Secondary: "Read Dedicated product brief"

Private:
Hero: "Inference in your network — VPC or on‑prem, compliant by design."
Subhead: "Private control plane, KMS/HSM integrations, audit logs."
Bullets: "VPC & on-prem options" / "Enterprise-grade security" / "Custom deployment models"
Primary CTA: "Contact enterprise team"
Secondary: "Request privacy datasheet"
```

Emma: This is great. Quick edits: shorten Hosted subhead to "Fast setup, predictable performance." Drop one bullet on Hosted (keep latency + cost + caching). Dedicated add explicit "pricing contact" line. Private add "audit-ready logs" phrase.

Maya: Updated microcopy will be posted shortly.

Zach: I'll mock the three hero variants and share a single frame Figma with toggle states by 10am tomorrow.

Liza: I'll wire UTMs, create SF mapping rules, and add webhook health check. Will post endpoint test logs here when done.

Noah: I'll build the dedicated demo script/benchmarks (throughput, p50/p90 latency, cost per 1k tokens).

ops-bot: Reminder scheduled: "Launch post — landing copy freeze" at 24h before 2971196400 (launch).

Emma: Final assignees: Maya (copy) EOD today; Zach (design) 10am tomorrow; Liza (routing & UTMs) EOD; Noah (SF mapping & demo) EOD. Thanks team — let's keep the hero consistent and make CTAs mode-specific. :rocket:

Maya: Posting first full draft in comments now.
